summary: Cybin Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a news release from Helus Pharma (Nasdaq: HELP) announcing completion of enrollment in the Phase 3 APPROACH study of HLP003 for Major Depressive Disorder, with topline data expected Q4 2026. The filing includes no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change. It is a routine business update on clinical trial progress. The registrant Cybin Inc. appears to have filed the report on behalf of Helus Pharma as a foreign private issuer. No deal terms are stated.
